macros.name: dateinputformat
macros.doc: This macro takes the name of the input format as single parameter, e.g., \dateinputformat{american}, for switching to American behaviour, e.i., mm/dd/yyyy.

macros.name: daterange
macros.doc: The command \daterange{#1}{#2} prints a date range in the current format.

macros.name: daymonthsepgerman
macros.doc: Change space between day and month in numeric date formats for the German language.

macros.name: isodash
macros.doc: Changes the dash in the ISO date format.

macros.name: isorangesign
macros.doc: Defines the sign or word that is printed between the two dates in a date range. e.g., in English the default is ‘ to ’.

macros.name: numdate
macros.doc: Switch to long numeric date format.

macros.name: origdate
macros.doc: Switches to the original date format.

macros.name: printdateTeX
macros.doc: The command \printdateTeX{#1} prints any date in the actual format.

macros.name: romandate
macros.doc: Switches to long numerical date format with month printed in lowercase Roman numerals.

macros.name: Romandate
macros.doc: Switches to long numerical date format with month printed in uppercase Roman numerals.

macros.name: shortdate
macros.doc: Switches to short numerical date format.

macros.name: shortorigdate
macros.doc: Switches to the short original date format.

macros.name: shortromandate
macros.doc: Switches to short numerical date format with month printed in lowercase Roman numerals.

macros.name: shortRomandate
macros.doc: Switches to short numerical date format with month printed in uppercase Roman numerals.

macros.name: twodigitarabic
macros.doc: Typesets the given counter with at least two digits.
